status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry and a company press release, Ashwoods Lightfoot Limited is currently active and was acquired by Volpi Capital in October 2021 [.

Ashwoods Lightfoot Limited.label: Ashwoods Lightfoot Limited (subsidiary of Volpi Capital)

claims.claim: Ashwoods Lightfoot Limited partners with Wireless Logic to provide multi-network IoT SIMs that connect the OBDII-plugged in-cab devices to their tracking and data analysis platform, allowing two-way communication via cellular data and SMS without localized network downtime.

The company reports that its core tracking platform feeds its Live Tracking App for Fleet Managers to view real-time data including vehicle orientation, speed, and GPS location map tracking alongside a "Last contact from Lightfoot device" timestamp.

A June 2026 performance study of nearly 100,000 UK commercial drivers utilizing Lightfoot's mobile app demonstrated a 9% improvement in fuel economy for active app users (averaging 26.6 mpg) compared to non-engaged drivers (24.3 mpg).

The company's web-based fleet management portal incorporates the InsightHub data visualization platform, "Fleet Doctor" engine fault code diagnostics, daily vehicle checklists, and business/private mileage toggles for compliance.

The company reports in a product update that its core in-cab coaching hardware device features plug-and-play installation via the vehicle's On-Board Diagnostic (OBD) port, completely removing the previous requirement for hardwiring or soldering into the ignition cable.

Ashwoods Lightfoot Limited has achieved third-party certification under the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standard for Information Security management and holds a Cyber Essentials Plus certification, as reported on the Lightfoot Fleet Compliance Solution platform.
claims.source: Lightfoot Website - Chief Technical Officer Role Page (https://lightfoot.co.uk)

claims.claim: Lightfoot provides a RESTful developer API (supporting OAuth2 and JSON structures via data.lightfoot.co.uk) that allows customers to pull real-time telematics, driver, and vehicle metadata into third-party scheduling, routing, fuel, and back-office enterprise systems, according to the official Lightfoot Driver API Documentation.
claims.corrected: Lightfoot provides a RESTful developer API (supporting Basic Auth and JSON structures via devapi.lightfoot.co.uk) that allows customers to pull real-time telematics, driver, and vehicle metadata into third-party scheduling, routing, fuel, and back-office enterprise systems, according to the official Lightfoot Driver API Documentation.

claims.claim: The company has executed high-volume enterprise deployments, notably rolling out its system across the supermarket delivery fleets of Asda and Iceland Foods, as well as a 2,500-vehicle utility fleet deployment for Network Plus, as reported in Lightfoot Customer Stories.
claims.source: Lightfoot Customer Stories (https://lightfoot.co.uk) and LinkedIn Video Transcript (https://linkedin.com)

claims.claim: A commercial technology partnership announced on April 14, 2025, integrates the company's in-cab coaching, telematics tools, and gamification app directly into the vehicle ordering stage for Volkswagen Financial Services Fleet (VWFS Fleet) leasing customers.
claims.corrected: A commercial technology partnership announced on April 14, 2025, integrates the company's in-cab coaching, telematics tools, and gamification app directly into the vehicle delivery or operational stages for Volkswagen Financial Services Fleet (VWFS Fleet) leasing customers.

claims.claim: A public sector implementation by Gateshead Council deployed the company's in-vehicle driver behaviour technology program within 10 municipal vehicles to monitor characteristics and deliver dashboard alerts.
claims.corrected: A public sector implementation by Gateshead Council deployed the company's in-vehicle driver behaviour technology program within 16 municipal vehicles to monitor characteristics and deliver dashboard alerts.

claims.claim: Financial filings registered with Companies House and analyzed by platform indicators show Ashwoods Lightfoot Limited generated an annual turnover of £18.4 million with a cash balance of £2.1 million.
An official corporate profile published by NatWest confirms that the company achieved £9.5 million in revenue during its scale-up phase and was recognized with the Megabuyte Emerging Star award.
claims.source: NatWest Insights Profile (UK tech scale-up: How Lightfoot became a winner)

claims.claim: An official strategic alliance announced on April 14, 2025, with Volkswagen Financial Services Fleet (VWFS Fleet) establishes the company as a Technology Partner to offer its full suite of in-cab coaching and telematics systems to VWFS Fleet's multi-marque leasing customers, allowing hardware installation at the vehicle ordering stage or during operation.
claims.source: Lightfoot Corporate Press Release & Fleet News

claims.claim: A dedicated partnership with global insurer Allianz, launched in 2015 and updated through May 2025, gives fleet policyholders exclusive discounts on the company's driver coaching and rewards technology as part of a proactive risk management approach.
claims.note: The update date of 'May 2025' is unconfirmed in published records regarding the alliance.
claims.source: Fleet News / Allianz Corporate News (2015 Partnership Announcement & 2023 Update)

claims.claim: The company reports that in 2025, it had 83,000 active vehicles operating on its fleet management platform, which together travelled 1.13 billion miles [1.21].
claims.source: Lightfoot Official Blog (Retail Fleet Trends in 2025)

claims.claim: The company announced that its technology has been deployed across over 50,000 vehicles as of 2022, representing an expansion from £3 million in revenue in 2018 to over £11 million in revenue in 2021 [1.23, 1.26].
The company reports a corporate size of 51–200 employees on its official LinkedIn organization profile.

status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, Volteras Technologies Ltd is an active private limited company under company number 12550040.

claims.claim: The company reports that its Volteras Connect API streams real-time OEM telemetry directly from manufacturers securely over AWS cloud infrastructure with a confirmed 99.9% uptime.
In its technical product specifications, Volteras reports that its proprietary algorithms and API infrastructure support data streaming refresh intervals as frequent as every 5 seconds.

Liquid Fleet selected Volteras in a project announced in December 2025 to optimize residual values, utilizing the platform's real-time vehicle location and odometer telemetry accessed via an online portal.

Volteras has an integration partnership with Mercedes-Benz Connectivity Services (announced in February 2024 and highlighted in November 2025) that streams vehicle data, battery state of charge, and diagnostics through the Volteras Connect API and Volteras Portal.

The company reports that its Volteras Connect API provides direct, hardware-free access to telemetry data from over 35 global automakers, specifically eliminating aftermarket hardware and installation needs.
The company announced that its information security management system achieved official ISO/IEC 27001 certification following an independent assessment.
claims.source: Volteras official announcement and DNV independent assessment confirmation (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/volteras_we-are-pleased-to-share-that-volteras-is-activity-7408808607598813184-CIjp)

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform architecture uses OAuth 2.0 client-credentials security and manages its Tesla integration consent flow to fully support Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) via Tesla.
claims.note: The detail regarding the use of 'OAuth 2.0 client-credentials security' for the general platform architecture is not mentioned in the source (the source specifies OAuth 2.0 is managed by Tesla for the consent flow).

claims.claim: Volteras provides the Volteras Connect API, streaming real-time telemetry from over 35 global automakers across 340+ vehicle models to support scaling from one to 10,000 vehicles.
claims.note: The specific detail regarding supporting scaling 'from one to 10,000 vehicles' is not confirmed by the published material.

claims.claim: In December 2025, vehicle leasing company Liquid Fleet completed onboarding onto the Volteras system to aggregate real-time odometer and location data via an online portal.
claims.note: The source states that Liquid Fleet 'aims to implement' or has partnered to onboard the platform, but there is no verification that they completely 'completed onboarding' onto the system in December 2025.

claims.claim: Liquid Fleet announced in December 2025 that it selected Volteras to provide connected vehicle data and real-time tracking for the majority of its 3,000-strong fleet by Q1 2026 to optimise vehicle residual values.

Volteras Technologies Ltd closed an $11.1 million oversubscribed Series A funding round in May 2025 led by Union Square Ventures, alongside corporate venture arms like WEX Venture Capital and Edenred Ventures, to scale its connected electric vehicle telemetry infrastructure (Yahoo Finance).
The company reported operational expansion driven by customer traction, growing its London-based staff from 5 to 18 people to service commercial fleet customers like Liquid Fleet (Fleet World).

Volteras Technologies Ltd partnered with the vehicle-as-a-service (VaaS) software platform Coastr in September 2026 to provide rental and leasing operators with hardware-free, OEM connected vehicle data.

Volteras Technologies Ltd signed a commercial partnership with vehicle rental and leasing provider Liquid Fleet to implement its data platform across the majority of its 3,000-vehicle fleet by Q1 2026.
Liquid Fleet announced in December 2025 that it chose Volteras to implement its platform across the majority of its 3,000-strong fleet by Q1 2026.

Volteras Technologies Ltd moved into new, larger offices in London and grew its operational team from 5 to 18 people, adding senior software engineers and customer success lead Steve Morrison, as reported by Fleet World.
Volteras Technologies Ltd maintains a registered office at 7 Princes Square, Harrogate, England, as confirmed by regulatory database filings.
